intent_contract.objective: Create a file-backed HTTP service and CLI that support session connect, send, and read flows using a shared service URL.
success_criteria: A service can create or update a session and persist messages under sessions/<id>.json and messages/<session-id>/*.json.
CLI clients can connect to a session with an agent id, persist that local client session state, and then send and read messages without retyping the session on every command.
End-to-end tests prove a remote client can connect, send, and read through the HTTP service.

out_of_scope: Any auth, RBAC, inbox, or coordination workflow beyond session messages
